model.title: A resolution recognizing the 80th anniversary of the Fullbright Program.

summary.text: The resolution recognizes the 80th anniversary of the Fulbright Program, a major international educational exchange effort. It supports the Fulbright Program and other educational and cultural programs as tools for advancing US foreign policy and national security. It congratulates all past and present Fulbright award recipients. It also encourages students, scholars, and professionals around the world to seek out chances to work together and build international understanding and partnership.
